capabilities: write content directly inside columns in Live Preview
set background and border colors for each column
open the plugin from the left ribbon icon
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; usage instructions in the README are limited to clicking the left ribbon icon.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to build multi-column layouts without code blocks or editing in Source Mode.
summary: Column layout plugin that creates editable multi-column sections styled and written directly in Live Preview.
